truth_frames.force_tared_raw_n: force link parent-body frame, tared, BEFORE the EMA and the obs noise
truth_frames.force_ema_n: same frame, the EMA buffer _force_smooth, BEFORE the obs noise
truth_frames.torque_tared_raw_nm: same frame, about the PARENT link origin (assumed, RT-192 measures it), weight moment tared, BEFORE the EMA
truth_frames.torque_ema_nm: same frame, the EMA buffer _torque_smooth, BEFORE the obs noise; = obs 28:31 in wrench mode
truth_frames.wrench_valid: False on the step _reset_idx touched the env (the wrench read there is the OLD episode's), True otherwise
truth_frames.tip_true_m: leading tool point from the pocket entrance, pocket frame, WITHOUT grasp offset or pocket noise
truth_frames.body_pose_w: tool_link = the OSC body, world, pos xyz + quat wxyz
truth_frames.osc_delta: held pose delta of the last action AFTER the step limits, BEFORE box/cone clamp (m, rad axis-angle)
truth_frames.osc_target_pose_w: OSC target AFTER cone and box clamp, world, from the LAST physics substep of the previous step; body_pose_w is read after that substep
truth_frames.interpen_max_m: SAPU max interpenetration, Warp mesh query; > 0 means touching, 0 does NOT prove free
